question: Does the conditional local-contiguity excess of route-new species replicate in two completely disjoint deterministic route sets?
split: SHA256(State:RouteNumber), first byte <128 = A, otherwise B; identical to the existing cross-fit route split.
endpoint: Adjacent-stop rain coefficient conditional on extra-stop incidence rain coefficient, using the same null-regression residual statistic as NAAMP_ROUTE_NEW_CONTIGUITY_V0_1.
pass_rule: Each fold must have observed conditional residual above the upper 95% residual interval under both null families. Overall replication passes only if both folds pass.
interpretation: Pass establishes internal replication across disjoint NAAMP route sets, not cross-continental universality or a causal hydrological mechanism.
